source: NCRB Crime in India 2022/2023 (built-in SafeCircle data)

zones.name: Delhi (NCT)
zones.reason: Highest among 19 metros: 1,204 rape cases in 2022 and 1,088 in 2023 (NCRB). Police attribute part of this to strict FIR registration.
zones.source: NCRB Crime in India (2022/2023). Registered FIRs, not all incidents.

zones.name: Jaipur
zones.reason: Second-highest among metros: 497 rape cases in 2022 and 573 in 2023 (NCRB). Rajasthan is also among the top states by absolute count.
zones.source: NCRB Crime in India (2022/2023). Registered FIRs, not all incidents.

zones.name: Indore
zones.reason: NCRB 2023 reported a crime-against-women rate per lakh higher than Delhi's. Madhya Pradesh is among the top states by rape cases.
zones.source: NCRB Crime in India (2022/2023). Registered FIRs, not all incidents.

zones.name: Lucknow
zones.reason: One of the 19 NCRB metros; Uttar Pradesh records among the highest absolute counts of crimes against women. Check NCRB city tables for exact figures.
zones.source: NCRB Crime in India (2022/2023). Registered FIRs, not all incidents.

zones.name: Kanpur
zones.reason: Higher-than-average dowry/crime-against-women rates among metros in NCRB 2023. Check NCRB city tables for exact figures.
zones.source: NCRB Crime in India (2022/2023). Registered FIRs, not all incidents.

zones.name: Ghaziabad
zones.reason: NCRB metro with elevated crime-against-women rates in 2023. Part of the Delhi-NCR belt; check NCRB tables for exact figures.
zones.source: NCRB Crime in India (2022/2023). Registered FIRs, not all incidents.

zones.name: Mumbai
zones.reason: 6,176 crimes against women in 2022, second among metros in volume (NCRB), but 196 rape cases in 2023, far fewer than Delhi or Jaipur.
zones.source: NCRB Crime in India (2022/2023). Registered FIRs, not all incidents.

zones.name: Bengaluru
zones.reason: 3,924 crimes against women in 2022, third among metros (NCRB). Large share is cyber and harassment-type cases.
zones.source: NCRB Crime in India (2022/2023). Registered FIRs, not all incidents.

zones.name: Hyderabad
zones.reason: Large metro with high cyber-crime-against-women volume (NCRB 2022). Check NCRB tables for rape and harassment counts.
zones.source: NCRB Crime in India (2022/2023). Registered FIRs, not all incidents.

zones.name: Patna
zones.reason: NCRB metro; Bihar reports elevated crimes against women. Check NCRB tables for exact figures.
zones.source: NCRB Crime in India (2022/2023). Registered FIRs, not all incidents.

zones.name: Pune
zones.reason: NCRB metro with moderate volume of crimes against women. Check NCRB tables for exact figures.
zones.source: NCRB Crime in India (2022/2023). Registered FIRs, not all incidents.

zones.name: Kolkata
zones.reason: Has had one of the lowest registered rates of crime against women among NCRB metros. Low reported rate is not zero risk.
zones.source: NCRB Crime in India (2022/2023). Registered FIRs, not all incidents.

zones.name: Chennai
zones.reason: Moderate reported rates relative to size among NCRB metros. Check NCRB tables for exact figures.
zones.source: NCRB Crime in India (2022/2023). Registered FIRs, not all incidents.
